description: This file defines the `DocModel` class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages and extracts documentation strings for AWS service models, including services, operations, errors, and shapes. It also provides functionality to convert documentation to array form and sanitize HTML content using the tidy extension.

classes.name: Aws\Api\DocModel
classes.description: Encapsulates documentation strings for a specific AWS service-version, providing methods for retrieving docs related to services, operations, errors, and shapes, as well as converting and cleaning documentation content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DocModel with a documentation array, throwing an exception if the tidy extension is not loaded.

methods.name: getServiceDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation about the overall service.

methods.name: getOperationDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a specified operation.

methods.name: getErrorDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation related to a specific error.

methods.name: getShapeDocs
methods.description: Retrieves documentation related to a shape, considering context and references.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Uses the tidy extension to clean and format HTML content.

search-terms: service, operation, shape, error docs retrieval
